gamePitch: a football-legacy collectible TCG set under the floodlights — four pitch domains (Striker's End, Engine Room, The Box, Back Line) where managers field squads against Rival Defense

world.title: The Pitch Legacy
world.description: Every match leaves a mark. Collect cards across Front, Mid, Box, and Back, push Attack to break lines, hold Defense that preserves legacy, and compete on a floodlit tactical board.

striker.visualIdentity: attacking third, far-post channels, finishing arcs, deep green and floodlight gold
striker.flavorNotes: poachers, far-post ghosts, finishing lanes, box runners, late arrivals, channel cutters

midfield.visualIdentity: centre circle, tempo switches, press traps, wet turf and cool greens
midfield.flavorNotes: tempo setters, switch-of-play artists, press traps, deep-lying orchestrators, half-space runners

box.visualIdentity: six-yard area, set-piece walls, penalty heat, clay terracotta and white floodlight
box.flavorNotes: set-piece walls, six-yard chaos, penalty architects, near-post blockers, delivery specialists

backline.flavorNotes: last-ditch blockers, high-line marshals, keeper's claim, recovery runners, shape holders

designRules: Mana 1–8 (most cards 3–6). Threat + Resolve should roughly scale with mana (stored as attack and health in JSON).
Roles vary: finishers, tempo pieces, set-piece specialists, shape holders, pressers — not assassins or burn decks.
Ability text must spell out keyword effects like the examples (do not assume the player knows keywords).
ability.name should be evocative and unique within the batch.
Use 0–2 keywords per card from the project glossary only.
Tone: football legacy — earnest, cinematic, floodlit — tactically interesting but never meme-y or trademarked.
Never use real club names, crests, kit trademarks, or FIFA branding.
Contests as breaking lines, holding shape, restoring Resolve, redirecting engagement, or drawing/linking — football-flavored, not gore.
Rarity tiers (from game/rarities.json): Reserve, Starter, Captain, Legend, Final Whistle — derived from mana unless rarity is set explicitly.
Subjects are stylized football moments / kit figures / pitch atmosphere — avoid readable real logos and prominent identifiable celebrity faces.

image.promptGuidelines: single focal football figure or pitch-side moment, photorealistic live-action sports photography, floodlight lighting, deep pitch green and clay accents, NO anime, NO illustration, NO text, NO card frame, NO watermark, NO real club logos, portrait 3:4 composition
image.promptSuffix: Photorealistic football-legacy product/character still, single focal subject, night floodlights, deep turf green, earnest mood, no anime, no illustration, no text, no border, no watermark, no club logos, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
image.notesGuidelines: negative prompts must ban anime/manga/illustration and real club trademarks; include palette, domain mood, and silhouette hints

rarities.notes: Tier ids (common, uncommon, …) match the DB enum. Display labels: Reserve, Starter, Captain, Legend, Final Whistle.
